title: agent frontmatter
description: The frontmatter of an agent file, which the rbtv installer reads and validates. The file's body, the agent's prompt, follows the template agent.md.

name.description: The agent's name: the file name without `.md` in a component's `agents/` folder, and the agent folder's name once installed.

description.description: First sentence enough to decide whether to invoke the agent; then the triggers and one near-miss.

skills.description: The skills this agent uses, by name; each name resolves to exactly one installed or installable skills, qualified as <module>/<component>/<name> when a bare name is ambiguous.

rules.description: The rules this agent uses, by name; each name resolves to exactly one installed or installable rules, qualified as <module>/<component>/<name> when a bare name is ambiguous.

commands.description: The commands this agent uses, by name; each name resolves to exactly one installed or installable commands, qualified as <module>/<component>/<name> when a bare name is ambiguous.

hooks.description: The hooks this agent uses, by name; each name resolves to exactly one installed or installable hooks, qualified as <module>/<component>/<name> when a bare name is ambiguous.

mcp-servers.description: The MCP servers this agent uses, by name; each name resolves to exactly one installed or installable MCP servers, qualified as <module>/<component>/<name> when a bare name is ambiguous.

folders.description: The agent's key folders: the folders it is expected to work in and navigate, relative to the installation root and written with forward slashes.
